0022600178.text: The Grizzlies host the Pacers in Memphis' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 6-1 overall (2-1 at home, 4-0 on the road) and second in the West, half a game behind for second in the Southwest, after a loss in their most recent game. Indiana is 2-6, 12th in the East, 4.5 games back in the Central, winless at home at 0-4, and on a five-game losing streak, and it is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not played yet this season, and Memphis won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 125-106 win in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
